outreach.to: Personal-finance blogger jisne haal me is topic pe post likhi ho
outreach.subject: A free paycheck tool for your readers
outreach.body:
Hi [Name],

I enjoyed your post "[their post title]" — especially [one specific point].

I run HomeMoney Calc, a free, no-sign-up set of US money calculators. Our take-home paycheck calculator might be a useful extra for that post: https://homemoneycalc.com/paycheck-calculator/ (example: $75,000 salary in California → $2,081 per paycheck).

If it helps your readers, you're welcome to link it or embed it (free embed code is at the bottom of the page). No pressure at all if it's not a fit.

Thanks,
[Your name]
Founder, HomeMoney Calc
outreach.rules: Personalize karo, ek-ek bhejo, din me 5 se zyada nahi. Paisa/link exchange kabhi offer mat karna.

Saw you cover [beat]. We put together a free table of 2026 take-home pay for the same salary in all 50 states: https://homemoneycalc.com/take-home-pay-by-state/

Best,
[Your name]
